text: 1.Non-Chinese citizen in good health with a valid passport;2.Applicants studying for a bachelor’s degree should have obtained high school diploma;3.High school graduate, GPA 3.0 or above（Note: 4-Point GPA System）4.IELTS (A) 6.5 or TOEFL IBT 90 or above received within the recent two years（TOEFL MyBestTM Scores accepted & TOEFL essentials）.Other internationally recognized English proficiency tests with scores of the same level and provide proof of certificates.
